description: Keeps the sandbox's tools current (SBX-011): the versions in docker/sandbox/Dockerfile and docker/sandbox/onedrop-tool, one weekly pull request. Dependabot keeps GitHub Actions current; the app's own Composer and npm packages aren't touched.

customManagers.description: A "# renovate: datasource=… depName=…" comment above a version line (ARG NAME=1.2.3 or name=1.2.3).

packageRules.description: Everything in one pull request a week: each merged change to the Dockerfile moves every sandbox to a new one once idle.
Agent CLIs on their own: the platform parses their JSON events, so each bump needs OpenCodeEvents, ClaudeCodeEvents or CodexEvents re-checked against the new CLI's output (AGENTS.md).
prBodyNotes: Before merging, re-check the events parser against the new CLI's real output: `opencode run --format json`, `claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose`, `codex exec --json`.

packageRules.description: PHP stays on 8.4 (users' apps run on it); only rebuilt 8.4 images (digests) come through.
The Google Cloud CLI's image tags are plain versions plus variants (alpine, slim, emulators); only the plain ones are its releases.
